name: anun333/oe-module-ccbhc-report
description: The CCBHC clinic-collected quality measures for OpenEMR: Time to Services, social drivers screening and depression screening, in the shape of SAMHSA's reporting template.

footprint-not-covered: Whether the measures match SAMHSA's own reading of its specifications. The unit tests hold each rule the manual states (business days, New Clients, the 14-day screen window, the five SDOH domains, the bipolar exclusion), and dev/ccbhc_report_check.py in the openhealthcare workspace checks them on synthetic records; no clinic's real submission has been compared yet.

Whether a restricted user sees only what they should. The pages check patients/med, patients/demo and admin/super as written above, and front office (demo only) was checked end to end; sensitivity-marked visits are not filtered out of the counts, which hold no clinical detail beyond the client list.
